## What this is

1.1.1 is 1.1.0 with the arm64 image added, and one label. The code is 1.1.0's, the chart changes only its version, and every setting, route and screen is what 1.1.0 has.

The label is `org.opencontainers.image.version`. The image never carried it, so reading the image's config showed no version. It says the release's version now, set from the same build argument the binary's version comes from.

## Why it is its own release

Multi-arch ships in its own run. 1.1.0 built amd64 only, went to production and read stable there, and this is the one small version bump that builds both. From here `stable`, `latest`, `1.1`, `1` and `1.1.1` all list amd64 and arm64.

## Upgrading, and going back

No migrations. `helm upgrade` to 1.1.1, or let `:stable` roll the Quadlet units. An arm64 box that has been pulling the arm64 image 1.0.2 shipped now gets the 1.1.1 one. Putting 1.1.0 or 1.0.2 back is safe, because nothing in the database changed.
